targets.title: There and back again: Can you compile that snapshot?
targets.evidence_quote: In this paper we have shown a replication and a reproduction study by Tufano et al. (2017) about the compilability of the history of past commits of a project. In the first one we have repeated their analysis, with those repositories for which we found all commits, and in the second one we extended its generality by using the same methodology with a different, more diverse set of Java projects, and considering also Ant and Gradle in addition to Maven.
targets.outcome_quote: -A partial validation of the results of the original study. In particular, results about frequency of errors causing build failures have been validated and extended.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly describe partial validation: error frequencies agree, while compilability is lower and generalization is partial. Both components are aggregated for the one original paper.
